svg.title: Commit rhythm
svg.desc: Hour of day against day of week for a sample of 296 commits, 14 Mar 2025 to 4 Sep 2026. Busiest slot is Thu at 18:00 with 15 commits. Read in UTC — every stamp in the sample came back without an offset. 17% of the sample is weekend work and 15% of it lands between 22:00 and 06:00. Shading runs in four bands by commits per slot: 1, 2–3, 4 and 5+.
svg.text: sample: last 50 commits per repo, 14 Mar 2025 to 4 Sep 2026
clock: UTC — every stamp in the sample came back without an offset
